title: Circulant Hadamard matrices
description: OpenAI's proof (2026) of the circulant Hadamard conjecture, usually attributed to Ryser: real circulant Hadamard matrices exist only in orders 1 and 4. The course works in the group ring of the cyclic group: it proves the local structure of cyclotomic integers near a prime and Turyn's restriction to orders 4u² with u odd, shows that alternating products of character values are roots of unity of odd order, and derives a contradiction modulo a prime above 2; even-length Barker sequences follow.

units.title: Circulant Hadamard matrices and group rings

prerequisites: core course Abstract Algebra II (rings, ideals, quotients, localization, Chinese remainder theorem)
core course Linear Algebra (diagonalization of commuting matrices of finite order)
